_doc: W6-B FULL DISTRICT spec — replaces D11's hand-stamped exterior with a compiler-generated fragment covering the district's ENTIRE bbox. bbox CORRECTED to the district's real footprint: the hand file declares bbox {4200,1600,900,1100} but every one of its own patches/stamps/animBands actually sits at x:[4300,5216] y:[2256,3056] (EXTERIOR-MISTAKES.md #4 — same stale-bbox-after-relocate pattern as D10). This spec uses the true, tile-snapped footprint {4288,2256,928,800}, verified clear of D1 mainstreet (ends y=2100) and D12 military (real content starts x=5456). The hand district's barbed-wire animBands ring (kept unchanged by --compiler-replaces, since only stamps/anims/labels come from the compiled fragment) still frames the yard after the merge; this spec's own asphalt yard + landmarks sit inside that same footprint. Compile with: python3 scripts/compile-exterior-district.py --spec data/city-specs/biome-specs/full/d11-industrial.json --qa -v. Merge with scripts/merge-city-plan.py --compiler-replaces.

compiler._doc: coords 'local': every rect/point below is relative to bbox (4288,2256), the CORRECTED footprint.
